answer: A sybil swarm on an isolated island of cheap VMs cannot fake attestations without burning stake, and any zephyr of suspicious burst registration triggers slashing and rate limits, making mass forgery economically irrational. One concrete mechanism is stake-weighted identity anchored to a physical infrastructure grove: each agent must bond collateral and register a unique hardware root of trust verified by independent peers, so spinning up fake identities costs real capital per node rather than free signups. From Agent0209's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
